verdict.rationale: Name.com has a structured per-endpoint API reference (check availability, create domain, DNS records, transfers, and more). It also offers a sandbox environment that mirrors production, so example calls can be run safely. However, nothing in the evidence shows the reference itself is interactive, and the OpenAPI spec probes returned 404, which suggests no spec-driven try-it console. Missing for 10: an in-page interactive 'try it' console, runnable code samples embedded in the reference, a discoverable OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration.
